press_references.value: Asana settles with Christian sex-ed nonprofit over discount dispute

legal_proceedings.description: Asana, a San Francisco tech firm, settled a legal dispute with Holy Sexuality, a Christian sex-ed nonprofit, over a denied 50% discount on its software. Holy Sexuality sued Asana for religious discrimination, claiming the company's policy violated California's Unruh Civil Rights Act. The case was dismissed after Asana agreed to provide the discount and remove the policy.

about_short_description.short_description: Asana is a software company that specializes in the fields of work management, productivity, team goals, and project execution.

product.name: Asana Work Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based work management platform for organizing tasks, projects, goals, dependencies, and team collaboration across an organization.

product.name: Agentic Work Management
product.description: A work management offering that coordinates human teams and AI agents in shared workflows with connected work data, permissions, and governance.

product.name: AI Teammates
product.description: AI agents that operate within Asana workflows to perform coordination and operational tasks using shared work context, memory, and governance.

product.name: AI Studio
product.description: A no-code automation tool for creating AI-powered workflows and automations within Asana.

product.name: Asana Dash
product.description: An AI assistant positioned as an organizational chief-of-staff tool for accessing and acting on work information.

product.name: Asana Service Management
product.description: An enterprise service management platform for managing service requests and workflows across IT, HR, facilities, and legal teams.
